comment: "An amazing course that is poised to boost the confidence and skills of practitioners interested in skin cancer care. Awesome!"

"One of the most interesting aspects of this course was understanding the different types of skin cancer, particularly and how their behavior, risk factors, and management differ. This course enhanced my ability to approach skin lesions systematically and reinforced the importance of timely diagnosis in improving patient outcomes."
"This course helped me to know more about carcinoma."

"I found the clinical features most interesting. Learning how to spot different skin cancers by their appearance made it feel practical. The link between UV exposure and DNA damage also made the topic clear and logical. I also liked how each type behaves differently, which helps in real diagnosis."
"I liked the inclusion of rare atypical cutaneous cancers."
